definition: What does it mean? What is the meaning of this? The essential question asked when inquiring about the definition or sense of a word, character, phrase, or gesture.
composition_note: 是 (to be) + 什么 (what) + 意思 (meaning/idea: both 意 and 思 share the 心 heart/mind radical). Literally: '[This] is what meaning?'. Often used with a word in front: '...是什么意思？' ('What does ... mean?').
en: What does it mean? / What is the meaning?
fr: Qu'est-ce que cela signifie ? / Que veut dire... ?

example.pinyin: Zhè ge cí shì shénme yìsi?

category: Classroom & Study Phrases / 学习与课堂常用语
note: A must-know phrase for all language learners. You can put any unknown word right before it: '[Palabra] 是什么意思？'.

definition: Do you have any questions? A classic teacher or speaker inquiry directed to students or an audience.
composition_note: 你们 (you all / plural) + 有 (have) + 问题 (questions/problems: 问 to ask + 题 topic) + 吗 (interrogative question particle). Standard affirmative answer: 有问题 (yǒu wèntí). Standard negative answer: 没问题 (méi wèntí).

example.zh: 同学们，你们有问题吗？—— 老师，我们没问题！
example.pinyin: Tóngxuémen, nǐmen yǒu wèntí ma? —— Lǎoshī, wǒmen méi wèntí!
example.ipa: [tʰʊ̌ŋ.ɕɥɛ̂.mən, nǐ.mən jòu̯ wə̂n.tʰǐ ma? —— làu̯.ʂʐ̩́, wǒ.mən měi̯ wə̂n.tʰǐ!]
example.en: Class, do you have any questions? —— Teacher, we have no questions / no problem!
example.es: Alumnos, ¿tienen alguna pregunta? —— Profesor, ¡no tenemos dudas / ningún problema!
example.fr: Chers élèves, avez-vous des questions ? —— Professeur, nous n'avons pas de questions !

category: Classroom & Study Phrases / 学习与课堂常用语
note: Standard classroom prompt used by Chinese teachers at the end of an explanation or class.

definition: No problem, no questions, sure thing; standard answer when everything is understood or when accepting a request.
composition_note: 没 (not have) + 问题 (problem / question). Dual meaning: (1) 'I have no questions / I understand' in class, (2) 'No problem / sure, I will do it' when agreeing.
es: No hay problema / Sin problema / Ninguna pregunta
en: No problem / No questions / Sure thing
fr: Pas de problème / Aucun problème / Pas de questions

example.zh: 你能帮我吗？—— 没问题！
example.pinyin: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma? —— Méi wèntí!
example.ipa: [nì nə̌ŋ páŋ wò ma? —— měi̯ wə̂n.tʰǐ!]
example.en: Can you help me? —— No problem!

category: Classroom & Study Phrases / 学习与课堂常用语
note: Extremely frequent in everyday conversational Chinese.

definition: Meaning, idea, sense, significance; also colloquial for 'interest' (有意思 = interesting) or a token of appreciation.
composition_note: Both characters carry the 心 (heart/mind) radical: 意 (phonetic 音 + 心 = feelings/mind's voice) + 思 (田 field of mind + 心 = thinking). The second syllable takes neutral tone.

example.fr: Apprendre le chinois est très intéressant.

category: Study & Common Nouns / 学习与常用词
note: Very versatile: 有意思 (yǒu yìsi = interesting), 没意思 (méi yìsi = boring), 小意思 (xiǎoyìsi = a small token / no big deal).
